questions.question: Name the province in which each of these is found: Table Mountain, the Waterberg, Lake St Lucia, Augrabies Falls and Algoa Bay.
questions.expected_answer: Table Mountain is in the Western Cape, the Waterberg is in Limpopo, Lake St Lucia is in KwaZulu-Natal, Augrabies Falls is in the Northern Cape, and Algoa Bay is in the Eastern Cape.

questions.question: Describe two of these features in detail: the uKhahlamba-Drakensberg, Lake St Lucia or Augrabies Falls.
questions.expected_answer: The uKhahlamba-Drakensberg is South Africa's highest range, on the border of KwaZulu-Natal and Lesotho, with peaks over three thousand metres, basalt cliffs and thousands of rock paintings; it became a World Heritage Site in 2000. Lake St Lucia is an estuary lake on the north-east coast of KwaZulu-Natal, part of the iSimangaliso Wetland Park, with hippos, crocodiles and pelicans. Augrabies Falls is on the Gariep River in the Northern Cape, where the river plunges into a granite gorge; its name means place of great noise.

questions.question: List the steps to find the main physical features of your own province.
questions.expected_answer: Find your province on a physical map; look at the colours to see whether it is high or low and find the highest areas; trace the blue lines to find the main rivers and which way they flow; look for lakes, dams, waterfalls, capes and bays; and find your own town and the features near it.
